entries.title: Alpha16–18 architecture audit and compatibility boundary
entries.carried: READ-ONLY audit of the alpha.15 tree: what it implements, the gap the target must close, the historical compatibility constraints it inherits and the coverage boundary of the evidence.

entries.title: Alpha16–18 cleanup and migration inventory
entries.carried: APPROVED POLICY inventory of every cleanup and migration object: KEEP / REFACTOR / REPLACE / RETIRE-after-qualification rows with named consumers, blockers and exit criteria, and the rule that nothing may be deleted from this list alone.

entries.title: Alpha16–18 current reality and contradictions
entries.carried: READ-ONLY audit of the 2026-11-03 reality and contradiction matrices, the boundary answers, the `__partProgram` production consumer map, the approved D-O1…D-O3 owner decisions and the remaining OPEN register O-1…O-10.

entries.title: Alpha16–18 fourth-pass reassessment: legacy disposition
entries.carried: APPROVED 2026-11-03 decision package P-1…P-5: retire the Class authoring API and Part Program v2 as a serialized protocol, remove `__partProgram` from the target generated-module ABI, retire the old validator/version, and build no authoring adapter — with the cost and option analysis behind it.

entries.title: Alpha16–18 freeze audit
entries.carried: The Alpha16–18 freeze gate: full chain map, source coverage ledger, consumer-matrix summary, contradiction register FR-01…FR-16, the remaining OPEN engineering register and the Alpha16a freeze statement.

entries.title: Alpha16–18 retirement roadmap
entries.carried: APPROVED POLICY retirement roadmap: per-object KEEP / REFACTOR / REPLACE / RETIRE disposition matrix with consumers and deletion preconditions, the phased Alpha16–18 plan, the Alpha16b class-retirement capability gate and the required evidence per retirement action.

entries.title: Alpha16 integration workboard
entries.carried: Coordination record: the M07 adjudications, the decided M07b technical plan (§13), evidence grades, merge order and the 2026-11-09 §14 Lead/QA acceptance.

entries.title: ADR-0108: npm distribution via `deno pack`
entries.carried: Deno-native npm distribution: a Deno workspace whose public packages ship as ordinary npm artifacts via the `deno pack` tarball generator; the Deno-native toolchain and consumer requirement are retired and the npm-only publishing half is restated in ADR-0161.

entries.title: ADR-0112: Protocol Types and Tiny Runtime
entries.carried: Standalone `@openelement/protocol` contracts package with a tiny runtime; the package left the tree at v0.40.0 and the shared contract types now live inside `@openelement/element`, whose multi-package boundary was superseded by ADR-0152.

entries.title: ADR-0156: Tree-SHA evidence reuse for the candidate gate
entries.carried: Tree-SHA evidence reuse for the candidate gate: a reuse chain judged by the producer's tree, with a refused claim falling back to the real gate; the mechanism was removed by the #1567 CI/Release redesign.

entries.title: ADR-0162: Element runtime/compiler package split — executed
entries.carried: Deferral of the Element runtime/compiler package split until measured evidence justified it; the split has since landed and the record is closed as executed.

entries.title: Agent Development Contract (internal maintainers copy)
entries.carried: The internal maintainers copy of the agent development contract: the canonical commands, the generated-file map, gate semantics and diagnostics consumption, every claim mechanically checked by tools/repo/check-agent-contract.ts.

entries.title: alpha16 candidate register (committed)
entries.carried: The committed X-id register of alpha15 residual work the alpha15 release PR referred to; entries named where their evidence lived. The working copy stayed outside the repository.

entries.title: Known-reds ledger (committed)
entries.carried: The committed view of the known-reds ledger: entries that make a gate red or bound what a gate can prove, each with symptom, evidence path, impact, owner, retirement condition and latest observation; status vocabulary OPEN / FIXING / FIXED / COVERED-BY-DESIGN.

entries.title: alpha15 cleanup batch — retrospective
entries.carried: The release/evidence lane's retrospective for the alpha15 cleanup batch: the decisions taken, each pointing at the lane evidence file or ADR that is the authority instead of re-narrating them.
